title: Discover Cox app

location.series: Cox Brand Collection — Lindsay Little / Periscope

slide_intent: Organize a service family into visible choices so the viewer can find a relevant path without reading a long explanation.
strategic_value: The repeated menu structure can make several Cox products feel like one coordinated offer.
demonstration: A tablet screen divides a mother-and-child photograph from five horizontal service and advisor menu rows.
practical_value: Keep the emotional image separate from the navigation and repeat the same row structure for each service.

content_islands.name: Lifestyle panel
content_islands.spec: Fill the left portion of the tablet screen with the mother and child using a device.

content_islands.name: Service menu
content_islands.spec: Stack the white service rows at right, aligning their circular icons at the boundary with the photograph.

content_islands.name: Device frame
content_islands.spec: Retain the black tablet frame to show the application’s intended physical setting.
